subject: Multi-cloud bundle floor and channel margin clarification
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hughes <oliver@eversecur.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-cloud bundle floor and channel margin clarification

Oliver — following up from last week's call. Two quick asks as we put together the private offer: 

1) Eversecur is interested in a combined AWS + GCP private offer that bundles the core model SKU (r4-inference) and an add-on for cross-region replication. They want a single list price for the bundle rather than two separate SKUs. Can you confirm whether your procurement / finance team requires us to maintain per-cloud list prices for marketplace compliance, or if a bundled single list is acceptable for your reseller/passback flow?

2) Channel margin expectations: your channel partner CloudResell (Katie cc'd) asked about the percent passback / reseller margin they need to remain commercially viable. We typically see 10–18% for strategic resellers on private offers; Eversecur hinted they'd need ~15% to include professional services. Can you confirm target margin range and whether any portion needs to be held back for marketplace fees?

I've attached a working spreadsheet (Eversecur_MultiCloud_Pricing_v2.xlsx) with three pricing scenarios (list-floor approach, flat-bundle, and metered-by-cloud). Please have procurement mark their preferred column and highlight any constraints on list-price floor or metering.

Next steps I propose: once you confirm bundle approach and target passback %, we'll prepare a private offer draft and a Marketplace Approved Pricing (MAP) PDF to route to CloudResell for contract.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0176
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Eversecur_MultiCloud_Pricing_v2.xlsx (Excel, 92KB)
From: Oliver Hughes <oliver@eversecur.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@eversecur.com, Katie Park <katie@cloudresell.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 11:37:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud bundle floor and channel margin clarification

Alex — thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement preference: single bundled list price is acceptable as long as the private offer documents include a clear SKU mapping for each cloud (required for our internal chargebacks). So we can accept a single bundle label for the customer-facing side, but procurement still needs the per-cloud breakout internally (your spreadsheet format looks fine).

- Channel margin: CloudResell is asking for 15% gross margin to cover implementation and first-year support. Marketplace fees (AWS/GCP) will be billed through the private offer and are expected to be deducted before passback; we can accept a passback calculation that uses net-of-marketplace-fees. 

Procurement attached a short procurement checklist (see inline comments in your spreadsheet) — primary constraint is that any list-price floor can't drop below 60% of published list for auditing reasons. If you need discretion on a one-off concession, we can escalate to finance but will need justification.

Can you share a proposed passback calculation (example: list * (1 - marketplace_fee%) * reseller_margin%) and a proposed MAP PDF for CloudResell to sign off? We aim to finalize terms by Friday.

Regards,
Oliver Hughes
Director, Cloud Engineering | Eversecur
oliver@eversecur.com

Attachment: procurement_notes.docx (DOCX, 18KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Oliver Hughes <oliver@eversecur.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Katie Park <katie@cloudresell.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud bundle floor and channel margin clarification

Oliver / Alex — looping in our pricing ops and channel leads. Ben here. Short answers and a proposal: 

1) Passback calc: proposed formula = bundle_list_price * (1 - marketplace_fee_pct) * reseller_passback_pct. For modeling, we used a conservative marketplace_fee_pct = 8% blended (AWS + GCP), but happy to update with your actual fee numbers. 

2) Reseller margin: we can support a 15% reseller_passback_pct on the combined bundle if the list-floor holds at >= 62.5% of published list (this gives us room for the blended fee and maintains unit economics). If procurement requires 60% floor, we can do a discretionary 1-2% additional rebate from Redwood to preserve partner economics for the first year only (subject to exec approval). 

3) SKU mapping: we'll include per-cloud breakout lines in the private-offer JSON manifest (for your internal chargeback). The customer-facing bundle will be a single line item in marketplace UI. 

Next steps: Alex / Laura will produce a short MAP PDF (Proposed-MAP-Layout.pdf) and the private-offer draft. Oliver — if procurement can confirm the blended marketplace fee or provide a small example invoice we can use to lock numbers, we'll finalize the private-offer number and route DocuSign by Thursday EOD.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud bundle floor and channel margin clarification

Oliver / team — attaching the MAP stub and a one-pager that shows three committed scenarios (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive). | Attachment: Proposed-MAP-Layout.pdf

- Eversecur procurement to confirm blended marketplace_fee_pct (one-line).
- CloudResell to confirm acceptance of 15% passback on first-year commercials.
- Redwood to prepare private-offer draft and send DocuSign link for signatures.

If we get those by Thursday morning we'll target DocuSign out Thursday afternoon. Thanks everyone — Laura
